beats.text: At the White House Easter Egg Roll, Trump sat down to color eggs with a bunch of little kids, then used the moment to relitigate Joe Biden's signature.

beats.caption: In a fight, we'd use the auto pen. He had an auto pen follow him around.
beats.label: via The Independent

beats.text: According to The Daily Beast, he told the kids Biden literally couldn't sign his own name. Real footage of Biden's bill signings shows him doing exactly that, by hand.

beats.caption: They'd follow him around with this big machine, you know what it's called? An auto pen.
beats.label: via The Independent

beats.text: The autopen conspiracy is his, not the kids'. Not one of them looked old enough to know what a Biden even is, let alone an autopen.

beats.caption: Joe Biden, he'd sign -- he was incapable of signing his name, so they'd follow him around with a big...
beats.label: via Reuters

beats.text: BuzzFeed and AOL both rounded this up as one of several odd tangents that day, alongside Melania's documentary and the Iran war. Egg roll, meet fever dream.
